Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

Dandy is seeking a strategic and hands-on Manager, Strategic Finance (GTM & Revenue) to own revenue forecasting and serve as the primary business partner to Sales, Marketing, and RevOps teams. You will play a critical role in driving growth strategy, optimizing resource allocation, and delivering actionable insights that help leadership steer the business.

The ideal candidate has deep experience in high velocity GTM motions and revenue forecasting, excellent analytical and communication skills, and a proven ability to influence senior executives in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

What You'll Do:

  • Strategic Financial Partner: Serve as the primary finance partner for Sales and Marketing, and RevOps. Bring a point of view, challenge assumptions, and make high-quality recommendations.

  • Revenue Steering & Reporting: Own the revenue forecast by segment & country, including pipeline and cohort inputs. Deliver revenue reporting with monthly variance commentary and key insights to help steer the business.

  • Performance Management & KPIs: Dive deep into areas of our business and figure out where we can set aggressive targets and then work with cross-functional teams to develop and execute initiatives around those recommendations.

  • GTM Efficiency & Unit Economics: Own GTM efficiency metrics and reporting, including CAC, payback, LTV, and retention by segment and cohort.

  • Process Improvement & Scalability: Improve planning and reporting workflows and automate recurring work. Identify operational inefficiencies and devise scalable solutions to enhance business performance and capabilities to support scale.

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of finance experience (FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, or private equity), including at least 3 years in-house at a high-growth company supporting GTM or revenue teams

  • Hands on experience building revenue forecasts, sales capacity, quota or comp modeling

  • Proven experience partnering with GTM leaders, with the ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to creatively solve complex problems in the face of ambiguity. Comfortable with being in the weeds and diving deep into the business and operating strategically

  • Demonstrated bias for action and a relentless pursuit of results

  • Excellent modeling skills and proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets

  • Ability to leverage AI tools in day-to-day work to drive efficiencies

  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to distill complex analyses into executive-ready insights

Req ID: J-871

Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

jobs.jobDescription:
Inventory Cost Accounting Manager
Location: Remote (US)

ABOUT BARK
Think Disney for dogs. We aren’t just selling toys; we’re creating the joy, connection, and delightful chaos that defines the bond between dogs and their people. At our core, we believe dogs make life better, and we’re on a mission to return the favor by building THE Dog Company.

We operate at the intersection of data, technology, and pure creativity. We move fast, test relentlessly, and use real feedback from millions of pups to build smarter systems, better products, and more meaningful experiences. We’re looking for people who want to challenge the status quo and help us invent what’s next for dogs and their humans.

THE TEAM
The Accounting team keeps BARK’s financial reporting accurate, reliable, and ready for the decisions that move our business forward. We own the monthly close, financial controls, and GAAP reporting that our internal teams and investors rely on.

As Inventory Cost Accounting Manager, you’ll report to the Controller and own the accounting for two of our biggest financial drivers: inventory and cost of goods sold (COGS). Our inventory moves across subscription boxes, retail partners, and direct-to-consumer orders, with new themed products every month, so the accounting is anything but static. You’ll lead a team of accountants and work closely with Purchasing, Fulfillment, Logistics, FP&A, and our systems teams to make sure the numbers reflect what’s actually happening across our business.

WHO WE’RE SNIFFING FOR
We’re looking for someone who knows inventory accounting inside and out, can lead a team through a clean, accurate close, and isn’t afraid to dig into the details when something doesn’t add up.

You bring strong accounting judgment, know how to turn complex inventory data into clear answers, and look for ways to make processes simpler and more reliable. You’re comfortable rolling up your sleeves, developing your team, and using technology and automation to make the work better. And, of course, you love dogs.

KEY DUTIES

  • Own inventory and COGS accounting across our 3PL warehouses and manufacturing partners, ensuring accurate inventory valuation and financial reporting.
  • Deliver a clean, on-time monthly inventory close and give Finance leadership a clear read on what’s driving COGS and gross margin, including reserves, landed and average costs, and purchase price variances.
  • Keep inventory audit-ready and controls tight. Review journal entries and reconciliations, oversee physical counts, support quarterly reviews and the annual audit, and document conclusions on complex transactions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of accountants, setting clear priorities, reviewing work, and helping the team deliver accurate results on time.
  • Improve how inventory accounting gets done. Partner with Operations, Finance, and systems teams to strengthen data accuracy, reduce manual work, and use automation and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to make reconciliations, reporting, and controls more efficient.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Strong experience in inventory and cost accounting, ideally within a consumer products, retail, manufacturing, or direct-to-consumer business.
  • Hands-on knowledge of inventory valuation, COGS, landed costs, reserves, and inventory reconciliations.
  • Solid understanding of US GAAP and SOX controls in a public company environment.
  • Experience leading and developing accountants, with the ability to balance hands-on work and team management.
  • Experience with NetSuite or similar ERP systems and inventory management applications.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate discrepancies, understand root causes, and explain what’s moving the numbers to the Controller, FP&A, and Operations partners.
  • A track record of improving accounting processes through better systems, automation, and data-driven workflows.
  • Comfort making judgment calls on gray-area inventory issues and keeping the close on track when priorities shift.

This is a full-time, remote position open to candidates based in the United States, with potential quarterly travel to New York City and our 3PL warehouses. We offer competitive compensation, equity, and benefits designed to support both you and your pack, including comprehensive healthcare and pet wellness coverage.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

  • The base salary range for this position is $115- $130K
  • This position is eligible for equity.

Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We’re looking for a Revenue Accounting Manager to join our growing Revenue & O2C Accounting team. In this role, you will support Oura’s retail business by owning and improving key revenue accounting processes, helping stand up scalable processes as new retailers and distribution partners are onboarded, and partnering closely with Technical Accounting to ensure revenue guidance is applied appropriately and implemented effectively. This role is well suited for a strong revenue accounting professional who enjoys partnering cross-functionally, improving processes in a growing environment, and translating accounting guidance into practical business execution.

Role Overview

As a Manager in our Revenue Accounting organization, you will:

Lead the team

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Revenue Accounting team by setting priorities, providing regular feedback, supporting performance management, and fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Build a high-performing, collaborative team culture by clarifying expectations, removing obstacles, and creating opportunities for team members to grow.

Support retail revenue accounting and close

  • Own and support monthly and quarterly close activities for assigned retail revenue areas, including journal entries, reconciliations, and flux analysis.
  • Record and analyze accruals, reserves, deferred revenue, AR-related entries, and other retail-related accounting entries in accordance with business activity and applicable accounting guidance.
  • Provide clear, concise analysis and insights on retail revenue trends, movements, risks, and key balances to Finance leadership and cross-functional partners.

Help operationalize revenue guidance

  • Partner closely with Technical Accounting to assess ASC 606 implications and help ensure accounting conclusions are applied consistently across retail programs, promotions, and operational processes.
  • Translate accounting guidance into clear process steps, documentation, and practical business requirements that can be executed consistently by the team.
  • Serve as a dependable accounting resource for cross-functional partners as retail programs evolve and new scenarios emerge.

Support retailer onboarding and process scale-up

  • Help stand up and refine scalable accounting processes as new retailers and distribution partners are onboarded, including transaction flow reviews, ERP setup validation, reconciliations, and close readiness.
  • Partner with Business Systems, Retail, RevOps, Logistics, and other stakeholders to support accurate transaction flows, clean data, and scalable execution.
  • Maintain and improve SOPs, process documentation, and supporting materials that enable strong controls, audit readiness, and repeatable execution.

Contribute to process improvement and cross-functional enablement

  • Identify process gaps, investigate root causes, and drive improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and scale across retail revenue accounting workflows.
  • Support Accounting and business partners with clear guidance, strong communication, and a practical approach to operational issue resolution.
  • Help strengthen documentation, controls, and close support in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What we’re looking for:

Required qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct experience with revenue accounting and ASC 606; a combination of public accounting and industry experience is strongly preferred.
  • At least 2 years of direct people-management experience, including setting direction, coaching and developing team members, and managing performance.
  • Demonstrated experience leading an accounting team’s day-to-day execution, including delegating work, establishing priorities, and ensuring timely, high-quality results.
  • Retail accounting experience, including exposure to retailer reconciliations, deductions or credits, reserves, and close support for large retail partner environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of ASC 606 and how accounting guidance should be translated into practical processes and operational execution.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort working through large sets of transactional data and operational process details.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain accounting topics in clear, business-oriented language.
  • High attention to detail, sound judgment, and a process-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Demonstrated people leadership, including setting direction, coaching, and performance management.
  • Strong systems and process mindset, with comfort digging into data, system flows, and configurations.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex accounting and process topics in plain language to cross-functional partners such as Sales/Commercial, FP&A, Rev Ops, and Business Systems.

Preferred qualifications

  • CPA (or equivalent) preferred.
  • Experience in high-growth and/or global organizations.
  • Familiarity with NetSuite or similar ERP systems, plus experience partnering with systems teams on revenue-related configuration and process support.
  • Experience supporting audits, preparing documentation, and operating in SOX-ready or public-company environments.
  • Experience helping build or improve templates, playbooks, and scalable documentation processes.

Location

  • Remote, United States
  • Open to candidates across continental U.S. time zones
  • Occasional travel may be required for team or cross-functional meetings

Benefits

At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave

About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Director Analyst serves as an insights leader within Gartner’s Business & Technology Insights group. Utilizing research and analytical skills, a Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer actionable solutions.

As part of Gartner’s Assurance Practice, you will join a dynamic team focused on advising Chief Audit Executives and their teams. You will be a trusted source of advice for clients, discussing complex client challenges and offering appropriate recommendations. This role includes both writing and speaking about best practices in audit planning and risk coverage. The Director Analyst of Internal Audit will also lead internal insight discussions among fellow analysts and collaborate with analysts across Gartner’s Assurance Practice.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing insights positions across a team of analysts

  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery

  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of experience or equivalent work experience

  • Internal audit experience

  • Applicable experience with and deep knowledge of the internal audit leader (or Chief Audit Executive) role as well as an industry perspective

  • Exposure to or working knowledge of common technology solutions utilized by internal audit leaders, such as audit management software tools

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop innovative and dynamic internal risk assessment and audit planning processes (including through the use of technology)

  • Demonstrated experience working across risk and control groups to improve coordination and risk coverage

  • Demonstrated experience developing audit coverage strategies for new and emerging risks

  • Executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

  • Strong business and financial acumen

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

The role of a Financial Analyst at Canonical

As a Financial Analyst, you'll be a core member of the FP&A Team and wider finance team. You will play a key part in our monthly business reviews, quarterly forecasting, annual planning, financial modeling, and continuously drive cross-functional business alignment. Our ideal candidate is a highly analytical independent thinker, who has a desire to learn how to leverage business judgment, driven by data, to advise on critical financial, commercial and strategic decisions.

Location: This is a remote role in Americas time zones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate insights into business operations by analyzing unit economics, drivers of variance, and other KPIs
  • Support quarterly and annual financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and monthly budget reviews
  • Provide analysis of commercial initiatives that have a strategic or financial impact on the business
  • Create objective analyses and processes for a fast-growing tech company to scale efficiently and make data-driven decisions
  • Support multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy
  • Partner with and communicate business progress to key stakeholders against financial and strategic targets

Valued skills and experience

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills
  • Curiosity and willingness to work on a wide range of projects
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets and financial modeling
  • Understanding of core accounting principles
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
  • Previous experience in an analytically focused finance or business role

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business, or related field
  • Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM and ERP systems
  • Experience with Budgeting and Planning Software, or Data Visualization tools

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a Direct Tax Lead to own our US income tax provision, compliance, and controls, reporting to the Head of Tax. ElevenLabs operates through its US entity and ~9 international entities and is growing fast, which means the provision, the compliance calendar, and the controls around them need a dedicated owner.

This is a hands-on ownership role. The provision and returns are prepared by external providers; you manage those engagements and are accountable for the output. You'll own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision (deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate rec, footnote disclosures), the US federal and state compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimated payments), and the technical work underneath it: §174 capitalization, §382 and NOL tracking.

You'll also assist in designing, documenting, and operating controls, and write the memos that support our positions, working directly with our Big 4 advisors and external auditors alongside the Head of Tax.

Requirements

  • Deep ASC 740 expertise at a multinational — provision, deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate reconciliation, and footnote disclosure

  • Experience owning a US federal and multistate compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimates)

  • Working knowledge of US international provisions (NCTI/GILTI, Subpart F, FDDEI, §163(j)) and how they flow into the provision

  • Experience managing Big 4 or equivalent providers and working directly with external auditors

  • Has built or operated SOX controls over tax, or supported a first SOX implementation

  • CPA

Bonus: pre-IPO or first-10-K experience, §174/§41 computation, §382 studies, equity compensation tax (ISOs, NSOs, RSUs), OneSource Tax Provision or similar.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Build and lead the direct tax team as we bring provision and compliance in-house

  • Expand into other strategic initiatives such as M&A, PE mitigation policy, corporate structuring.

  • Broaden into wider tax leadership as our footprint grows

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the east coast, New York preferred.

ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love.

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.

    • You have built and retained an accounting team of meaningful scale and complexity, including both managers and individual contributors

    • You have designed and managed full-cycle accounting close and operations, and managed related areas including tax, treasury, payroll, and equity administration

    • You have led accounting teams through multiple clean audits with Big Four firms

    • You have a proven track record of scaling finance operations through major process or systems overhauls, including experience incorporating AI-powered workflows

    • You have overseen global indirect tax compliance, including US sales tax and international VAT/GST

    • Scrappiness - Tendency to prioritize rigorously and preference for quality over volume. Demonstrated growth-mindset and willingness to own additional areas of responsibility as needed

  • Experience with emerging AI-native finance tooling, e.g. Rillet

  • Experience with business combination accounting and integrations

  • An active CPA license

Job Title: Financial Analyst (P2)

Location: Remote

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our Financial Analyst will be pivotal to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Finance team and will be a critical partner in scaling the company by building key business relationships across the organization. We believe that the most successful SaaS businesses rely on agile, data-driven finance partners who look beyond budget variances to turn operational data into strategic growth.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for serving as the dedicated finance partner to our Customer Success, Professional Services, and G&A organizations alongside our FP&A leadership. Specifically, you will:

  • Lead Financial Partnering: Support departmental heads with headcount management, monthly budgeting, forecasting, and actuals variance analysis.
  • Maintain Revenue & Retention Metrics: Own the source of truth for retention and churn forecasting models, partnering directly with Revenue Operations and Order Management to ensure data integrity.
  • Drive Executive Reporting: Prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting—analyzing financial results, identifying key operational trends, and communicating insights to senior leadership.
  • Leverage Modern Tech & AI: Utilize Pigment as our core FP&A planning platform and Claude AI to accelerate data analysis, reporting, and scenario modeling to automate finance workflows.
  • Execute Strategic Modeling: Perform ad-hoc financial modeling and scenario analyses to evaluate operational risks and strategic business initiatives.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our ‘team over self’ core value, you will also have the opportunity to work directly across different management levels to solve complex financial challenges and shape how we scale a world-class revenue platform. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking a self-motivated, customer-centric, and highly analytical problem solver who is passionate about making an impact. You are an independent thinker with an eye for process improvement, comfortable navigating fast-paced environments, and eager to leverage cutting-edge tools to automate finance workflows. If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Financial Analyst is the career path for you!

Our Clari + Salesloft Finance team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming finance and analytics professionals who are all aligned on one vision and mission:

  • Vision: Fundamentally transform the way buyers and sellers drive repeatable outcomes
  • Mission: Bring science to the art of sales

The Finance team consists of results-oriented SaaS professionals with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for strategic problem solving. The team members share a few common traits: they are collaborative, highly curious, detail-oriented, and focused on helping the company scale cleanly.

THE SKILL SET:

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in FP&A, Sales Operations, or quantitative financial analysis roles within a high-growth tech or B2B SaaS environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets for financial modeling.
  • Hands-on experience with modern FP&A platforms (specifically Pigment) and comfort using AI tools (such as Claude AI) to drive analytical productivity.
  • Solid understanding of core SaaS post-sales business metrics (e.g., NRR, GRR, Churn, ARR).
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills to interact effectively with business partners and executive management.
  • High adaptability and problem-solving skills; comfortable working in a fast-paced team with evolving priorities.
  • Collaborative mentality by prioritizing ‘we’ and not focusing on ‘me’.

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview at https://salesloftbenefits.com/

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners with AI agents. They are based in San Francisco and have raised over $125M+ in venture funding from top Silicon Valley investors to accomplish their ambitious vision, including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

Fieldguide has become the defining agentic company for CPAs, with more than 50%+ of the top-100 CPA firms as customers, including several Big 4, and an industry-leading NPS to match. They save up to 75% of time on manual tasks and unlock over 4x capacity for audit practitioners, helping provide the work-life balance that is rare in the profession. Fieldguide is on the same growth curve as the later-stage vertical AI leaders, but you would be joining early enough to have a meaningful impact.

Fieldguide values diversity, both in backgrounds and in experiences to help build the future of audit and advisory. They are deliberate in preserving a winning culture with their FFLOWI values - Fearless, Fast, Lovable, Owners, Win-Win, Inclusive - providing space for teammates to do their career’s best work through a tightly-knit support network.

If you want to shape the most important shift in how commerce and capital markets establish trust, alongside world-class teammates, Fieldguide would love to build with you.

About the Role

The Director, Audit Transformation will lead the shift from traditional audit execution to an agentic operating model. Reporting to the Head of Audit, you will set the direction for how financial audit agents are designed, adopted, and scaled across our customer base.

You will serve as the connection point between the Fieldguide agentic platform and the profession it serves. In partnership with product, engineering, sales, and customer success, you will define the scope of the audit expertise behind an agentic operating model rather than layering agents onto legacy processes, including the documentation required to satisfy professional standards and withstand regulatory inspection. With Customer Success, you will establish the change management framework that guides firms from initial adoption through full transformation, built for consistent delivery at scale.

You will also support the Head of Audit on the strategic planning and special initiatives that translate audit strategy into execution and go to market initiatives.

This role calls for a leader with audit credibility earned through leading engagements, shaping methodology, or driving innovation within a leading firm, together with the conviction that professional judgment remains central to the audit. This is an opportunity to define how audit is delivered in the next decade, not to refine how it is delivered today.

What You’ll Do

Product Partnership

  • Serve as the audit domain expert in product discovery, prioritization, and roadmap planning for agent-based workflows, translating practitioner and firm needs into product specs

  • Work with AI architects and engineers to translate professional standards and practitioner judgment into the prompts, workflows, and guardrails behind our integrated methodologies and testing agents

  • Determine which procedures are suitable for agent execution, what level of autonomy is appropriate, and how output must be documented to satisfy professional standards and withstand regulatory inspection

  • Pressure-test new agent capabilities with practitioners before they ship, creating a tight feedback loop between the field, Methodology, and Product

Customer Transformation

From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Staff Cash Accountant to support our high-volume cash operations. This role is critical in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of cash application, reconciliations, and reporting across multiple revenue streams and systems.

You will work cross-functionally with the Treasury, A/R and A/P teams to streamline processes, improve automation, and maintain strong internal controls in a fast-paced, transaction-heavy environment.

Key Responsibilities

Daily Cash Management & Reconciliation

  • Perform daily cash postings across multiple bank accounts and entities.

  • Support Treasury with daily cash position reporting and liquidity insights.
  • Perform high-volume daily and monthly bank reconciliations across 40+ accounts

Month-End Close

High-Volume Transaction Management

  • Monitor and maintain cash clearing accounts

Process Improvement & Automation

Internal Controls & Compliance

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Natera is seeking a hands-on Finance Functional Lead, Oracle Fusion Cloud within IS&T to serve as the single functional owner and key point of contact for Finance leadership across an aggressive Oracle Fusion Finance transformation. This role owns Oracle Fusion Financials end-to-end, from roadmap and backlog to hands-on configuration, delivery, and adoption and is the primary IS&T partner for the Controller, Senior Finance Leadership, and Accounting organization.

This role owns product outcomes, finance domain delivery, automation impact, and audit readiness. The candidate will govern an offshore MSP for KTLO support while personally owning all net-new initiatives and capabilities within the Finance domain. Not just requirements gathering or ticket execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Ownership: Own the product vision, roadmap, sprint planning, and backlog for Oracle Fusion Financials, including GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash Management, Project Accounting, Lease Accounting, Consolidations & Eliminations, Intercompany, Expenses, Billing, Revenue, Tax, Treasury, Cost Accounting, and FP&A enablement.
  • Single Owner - Finance Domain Delivery: Serve as the sole accountable owner for all Oracle Fusion Finance net-new initiatives from design through go-live. Own delivery roadmap, prioritization, and outcomes end to end with no hand-offs. Drive at pace in a high-velocity, high-expectation Finance environment.
  • Key Business POC - Finance Leadership Partnership: Act as the primary point of contact for the Controller, Senior Finance Leadership, and accounting teams. Translate business requirements into system design, present solution decisions clearly, and build trusted relationships that position IS&T as a strategic partner and not like a ticket queue.
  • Offshore MSP Governance - KTLO Oversight: Direct and govern the offshore managed service partner (MSP) responsible for keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) support across Finance modules. Set quality standards, review deliverables, escalate risks, and ensure MSP execution meets business SLAs while staying focused on transformation.
  • Solution Delivery: Perform hands-on functional configuration and system changes within Oracle Fusion Financials, including setups, controls, and process improvements. Lead end-to-end delivery including testing, training, documentation, quarterly upgrades, release readiness, and production stability.
  • Consolidations, Eliminations & ARCS: Own solution analysis, functional design and delivery of financial consolidation and intercompany elimination processes. Lead implementation and optimization of Oracle Account Reconciliation Cloud Service (ARCS) including reconciliation templates, compliance workflows, period-close dashboards, and GL integration.
  • Project Accounting & Lease Accounting: Implement and sustain Oracle Fusion Project Accounting (project costing, billing, capitalization, GL/FA integration) and Lease Accounting.
  • Period Close, Audit Support & Compliance: Own functional configuration supporting month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close (reconciliations, subledger close, intercompany eliminations, and financial reporting). Support SOX walkthroughs, prepare audit PBC documentation, maintain control documentation, and drive audit remediation within Oracle Fusion.
  • Intelligent Automation Delivery: Design, implement, and drive AI and intelligent automation across close, billing, reconciliations, T&E, tax, and treasury processes, utilizing Oracle AI and other automation frameworks. Identify opportunities to rationalize manual workarounds with native Oracle capability.
  • Integrations: Collaborate with integration and engineering teams on extensions and integration of adjacent Finance applications (e.g., Concur, Workday, Blackline, Workiva, Adaptive), providing functional leadership, validation, and business context.
  • Trusted Reporting: Understand Finance reporting & analytical requirements and deliver dashboards, KPIs, and insights using Oracle tools (BIP/OTBI) or by partnering with BI/Analytics teams.
  • SOX Compliance & Audit Readiness: Ensure system configuration supports SOX-compliant financial controls, proper segregation of duties, and audit traceability across all Finance modules.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of hands-on experience owning/supporting Finance ERP platforms within IS&T/IT with Oracle ERP implementation expertise.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Financials - functional configuration, data analysis & reporting (BIP/OTBI), testing, and production support.
  • Deep, practical knowledge of core finance and accounting processes including Record-to-Report, Close, Billing, Revenue, Cost Accounting, Tax, Treasury, and FP&A.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Consolidations & Eliminations within Oracle Fusion.
  • Finance and accounting foundation CPA, CMA, or direct GL/AP/AR/close/audit experience strongly preferred. You understand the books, not just the system.
  • Offshore MSP management experience: ability to govern, direct, and hold accountable a third-party delivery team across KTLO and support functions.
  • Executive communication skills: proven ability to present, influence, and partner directly with Controllers, VPs of Finance, and senior accounting leadership.
  • Experience utilizing AI capabilities in transforming Finance operations.
  • Direct experience integrating and governing best-of-breed Finance applications.
  • Strong financial and analytical expertise with deep knowledge of Oracle Finance core data structures to enable accurate financial reporting.
  • Strong SOX, audit, and regulated-environment experience.
  • Thrives in aggressive, high-velocity environments with shifting priorities and high Finance leadership expectations.
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented, and business outcomes mindset.
  • Strong project/program management skills and experience in Agile/iterative delivery models.
  • Commitment to clear documentation, governance, and operational rigor.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working at a Big 4 or Tier-1 consulting firm (e.g., Deloitte, Accenture, EY, PwC) delivering Oracle Finance or enterprise ERP solutions.
  • Oracle Fusion ERP/Financials certifications.
  • Project Accounting, Lease Accounting implementation experience
  • Experience supporting Finance platforms through M&A, integrations, or rapid business scale.
  • Life sciences, diagnostics, or medical device industry experience.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

The Finance Systems team is seeking an experienced Netsuite Systems Manager with strong functional and IT support experience to join the team. In this individual contributor role you will be responsible for administration, configuration, and support for our Netsuite ERP system and associated Finance Business Systems. Additionally, you will be a Finance Systems thought leader and champion of best IT/functional practices, IT General controls, and process improvement automation. Reporting directly to Sr Director of Finance Systems, you will collaborate closely with Business Application, Sales Operations, IT, and our Finance team. This position is 100% remote.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Netsuite System Administration

  • Own day-to-day operations of NetSuite, and other Finance Business systems including hands on user support and troubleshooting.
  • Administer and support the NetSuite ERP system, focusing on Financial, Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), and Zone billing module
  • Perform system configuration, customization, upgrade and maintenance along with compliance in change management, ITGC, and SDLC processes.
  • Develop and maintain workflows, custom fields, and scripts.
  • Manage NetSuite integrations with other business systems.
  • Oversee user access management, SOD Reviews, and annual/quarterly review process to resolve segregation of duties conflicts.
  • Oversee the governance, change management, end to end maintenance including general ledger accounts, cost centers, products, and any other necessary structures to support the reporting needs of key stakeholders. Manage ticketing system for tracking open cases/change request to resolution
  • Optimize system settings, workflows, and customizations for maximum efficiency.
  • Ensure data integrity and compliance with SOX regulations.
  • Provide training and support to end-users.

Program Management

  • Manage/Configure finance transformation projects focusing primarily on the order to cash cycle, encompassing Lead/Opportunity, Contract Management, Quoting/CPQ, Order Management, Revenue Recognition, Billing, Credit, Collections/Disputes, and Cash Application processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Legal,Engineering, Finance and IT to gather requirements and implement solutions that enhance business processes.
  • Identify, scope, and prioritize projects based on business needs. Develop detailed project plans, including approach, timelines, milestones, and resources, ensuring on-time and within-budget project delivery.
  • Define data-driven frameworks and processes to identify, measure, and manage program success, focusing on business value, including benchmarking.
  • Ensure procedures, processes, and proper change controls are followed on all production changes and implementation projects
  • Work with sales operations and biz app teams on system enhancements.

Dashboard Creation and Reporting

  • Utilize NetSuite's native tools and our very own Grafana dashboard to create high-performing dashboards tailored to Finance needs.
  • Develop reports and visualizations to provide actionable insights from finance data.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in computer Science, information technology, accounting, finance or a related field.
  • 6+ years of progressive experience with as a Finance System Administrator with Netsuite and financial systems tools such as Zip, Avalara, Expensify etc
  • Hands-on IT support experience, including troubleshooting and resolving functional & technical issues.
  • Experience with data migration, data mapping, and data integration within Netsuite including the Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) module including Zone and Company billing module,and Salesforce integration.
  • Administrator-level knowledge of privileged access, content groups, multiple charts of accounts, dynamic approval chains, custom objects, tax codes, tolerances, custom workflows, supplier configuration, and report building
  • Knowledge of ITGCs and experience working in SOC, ISO, and SOX compliant environments
  • Demonstrated experience integrating accounting systems with Salesforce / SFDC, ideally including CPQ and experienced level with Netsuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM)
  • Experience with project management concepts and tools such as Github, Monday.com and Miro.
  • Sharp analytical skills coupled with the ability to troubleshoot complex system issues with ease
  • Knowledge of core accounting processes such as order to cash, procure to pay, record to report.
  • Highly motivated with the ability to work in a rapidly changing global and remote environment
  • You work well in both a team environment and independently
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to speak cross-functionally

Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

jobs.jobDescription:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About the Role

As Headway's Senior Accounting Manager, you will lead day-to-day accounting operations and help establish scalable financial processes during a period of rapid growth. You'll manage a team of four accountants, owning month-end close, financial reporting, and technical accounting under US GAAP. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll coach a high-performing team while partnering cross-functionally with Finance, People, Legal, Data, Product, and Engineering to ensure accurate and timely reporting. This role offers an opportunity to apply strong leadership, technical accounting expertise, and creative problem-solving to make a lasting impact on Headway's operations and audit readiness.

You will:

  • Manage and develop a team of 3+ accountants — setting priorities, reviewing work, providing feedback, and coaching them on technical accounting and process improvements.

  • Take a lead in automating accounting workflows using AI and LLMs (e.g., journal entry preparation, reconciliations, flux analysis, audit support), and lead the team in adopting these tools responsibly.

  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close process end-to-end, ensuring journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, and account analyses are accurate, complete, and delivered on schedule.

  • Review and approve journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and flux analyses prepared by the team.

  • Lead technical accounting research and policy setting under US GAAP, including documenting accounting positions and memos for complex transactions

  • Support the annual audit by coordinating PBC requests and responses across the team, partnering with the Assistant Controller (who serves as the primary point of contact for external auditors.)

  • Partner with the People team to oversee payroll accounting and reconciliations, and with cross-functional teams (Finance, Data, Engineering, Product) to scale accounting operations.

  • Drive process improvements and automation initiatives across the accounting function, leveraging tools like Netsuite, Workday, and Ramp to reduce manual work and improve controls.

  • Lead or sponsor strategic accounting projects, coordinating cross-functional partners and delivering measurable business impact.

You'd be great for this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of accounting and/or audit experience, including at least 5 years managing a team

  • A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or another relevant field (CPA preferred but not required)

  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and experience leading month-end close in a high-growth environment

  • Public accounting (Big 4 or large firm) and/or in-house experience at a high-growth or pre-IPO company

  • History of utilizing LLM’s such as Claude to automate processes.

  • A track record of coaching and developing accounting talent

  • Hands-on experience with Netsuite (and ideally Numeric and Ramp), and a bias toward using technology to scale accounting operations

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and partner effectively across functions

  • A proactive, ownership mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

Comprehensive benefits:

Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave.

Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Finance Team

Thumbtack’s Finance team is the trusted steward of the company’s resources and a genuine partner to the business. We do not just report the numbers; we help decide where the next dollar goes. Corporate FP&A sits at the center of that work, owning the consolidated forecast, the annual plan, and the reporting that leadership and our Board rely on. We are also rebuilding how finance work gets done, using AI to take the manual grind out of reporting so the team can spend its time on judgment instead of assembly. It is a small, high-trust team with unusually direct access to the decisions that shape the company.

About the role

As Corporate FP&A Manager, you will own the consolidated view of Thumbtack’s P&L — the forecast, the annual plan, and the reporting that goes to our leadership team and Board. This is a high-scope individual contributor role with direct exposure to the CFO and the Finance leadership team. You will also help rebuild how the work gets done: we are actively replacing manual FP&A processes with AI-assisted workflows, and we want someone who is excited to lead that, not just tolerate it. If you want to sit close to the decisions and help build a finance function that is ready for the next stage of the company, this is that seat.

What you’ll do

  • Own the consolidated monthly and quarterly P&L close process for FP&A, including forecasting, variance analysis, and the narrative that explains what actually happened

  • Run the annual budgeting cycle end to end, from bottoms-up build through executive review

  • Build management and Board-level reporting, including Board decks, quarterly outlooks, and analysis that supports investor conversations

  • Apply AI and workflow automation to core FP&A processes, replacing manual reporting and reconciliation work with something faster and more reliable

  • Collaborate across Business Finance, Strategic Finance, Accounting, and Business Analytics to keep one consistent view of the numbers

  • Lead ad hoc analyses and scenario modeling for the CFO and the leadership team on the questions that matter most that quarter

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia.   • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst, Technology to own the FP&A for our Technology organization. Reporting to the Director, FP&A, you'll be the finance owner for the day-to-day planning, forecasting, and analysis of one of the company's fastest-scaling and most strategically important cost centers; from headcount and equity to cloud and commercial inference infrastructure. You'll own the monthly forecast end to end, build the models that explain where the money goes and why, and partner directly with Technology and Finance leadership to turn operational decisions into sharp financial trade-offs. It's a high-impact, high-visibility role with real ownership and a direct line to the leaders shaping one of the most exciting parts of our business.

You Will:

  • Own the tactical execution of the monthly forecast for the Technology organization, including headcount cost, equity, stock-based compensation (SBC), and other operating expenses.

  • Lead detailed budget-versus-actuals (BvA) analysis each month, surfacing drivers, explaining variances, and flagging risks and opportunities to Finance and Technology leadership.

  • Prepare the monthly budget deck and supporting analysis, turning the numbers into a clear narrative that leadership can act on.

  • Manage headcount pacing and partner with hiring managers on trade-offs across open roles, timing, and backfills against the plan.

  • Own other opex pacing across the Technology org, partnering with budget owners to keep spend aligned to plan.

  • Build and maintain detailed models for cloud and infrastructure spend, including commercial inference and other usage-driven costs, and partner with Technology leaders to forecast, pace, and optimize this spend.

  • Drive resource tagging and initiative-level tracking so that spend is transparent, attributable, and tied back to the work it supports.

  • Partner with Technology and Finance leadership on trade-off decisions, budget understanding, and the financial implications of strategic and operational choices.

You Have:

  • B.S. in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 4+ years of experience in FP&A, finance business partnership, strategic finance, or a related analytic field.

  • 4+ years of experience building and manipulating financial models and large data sets in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • A strong command of forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, with the ability to move fluidly between the details and the big picture.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with non-finance partners and translate financial concepts for a technical audience.

  • A bias toward ownership and action — comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience partnering with a Technology, Engineering, or Product organization.

  • Familiarity with cloud/infrastructure cost modeling (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure) and usage-based or consumption-driven cost structures, including AI/ML compute or inference spend.

  • Experience with equity and SBC forecasting.

  • Experience with ERP and planning systems (e.g., Oracle NetSuite, Anaplan, Pigment, or similar).

Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are seeking a Manager, Global Financial Reporting to play a critical role in strengthening and scaling the Company’s financial reporting function as the business continues to grow and operational complexity increases. This role will support the preparation of high-quality financial statements and disclosures, drive reporting process maturity, and help build a scalable, well-controlled financial reporting environment.

This position will work cross-functionally to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent financial reporting across the organization while supporting audit execution, internal controls, and public-company readiness initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end preparation, drafting, and compilation of quarterly (Form 10-Q) and annual (Form 10-K) financial statements, including complex footnotes, disclosures, and Management’s Discussion and Analysis (MD&A).
  • Prepare consolidated and standalone financial statements and disclosures to support both global regulatory reporting and local statutory requirements.
  • Stay abreast of evolving SEC regulations, PCAOB standards, and FASB updates; evaluate their impact and update accounting and financial reporting policies accordingly.
  • Support the monthly and quarterly close processes, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial reporting that meets accelerated public-company timelines.
  • Support the consistent application of U.S. GAAP accounting policies across global subsidiaries through technical guidance and structured review.
  • Review significant contracts, M&A activities, and unique transactions to assess financial reporting, accounting treatment, and SEC disclosure implications.
  • Support goodwill impairment and segment reviews.
  • Act as a primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit deliverables, timelines, and the resolution of complex reporting and disclosure issues.
  • Strengthen the control environment by identifying and mitigating financial reporting risks through proactive Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) monitoring.
  • Lead financial reporting process documentation efforts (XBRL tagging review, disclosure checklists), identify control gaps, and support remediation initiatives.
  • Support the drafting and tie-out of Form 8-Ks (including earnings documentation), Proxy statements and additional filing types.
  • Drive continuous improvement, automation, and standardization in financial reporting workflows to reduce close cycle times.
  • Support long-term scalability and readiness for public-company reporting requirements, ensuring reporting infrastructure keeps pace with company growth.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education & Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; CPA license required; Big-4 preferred.
  • Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience with financial reporting experience at a publicly traded company. Cash Flow and EPS experience is highly preferred.
  • SEC Technical Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience preparing and reviewing Form 10-K and Form 10-Q filings, with a strong command of SEC rules, regulations, and U.S. GAAP.
  • Systems & Tools: Familiarity with modern financial reporting and SEC filing software (e.g., Workiva, ActiveDisclosure) and ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP) is highly preferred.
  • Execution Skills: Highly self-directed and accountable, with a proven ability to deliver against strict SEC timelines and competing demands.
  • Soft Skills: A collaborative critical thinker who can work effectively across functions and levels, foresee potential reporting obstacles, and propose alternative, compliant approaches.

At ŌURA, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at ŌURA has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health and add to our benefits!

  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave
  • Amazing culture of collaborative and passionate coworkers
